@redhat-chai-bot: This pull request references [TRT-2777](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/TRT-2777) which is a valid jira issue.

Warning: The referenced jira issue has an invalid target version for the target branch this PR targets: expected the bug to target the "5.0.0" version, but no target version was set.

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/cluster-cloud-controller-manager-operator/pull/487):

>Reverts #479 ; tracked by [TRT-2777](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/TRT-2777)
>
>Per [OpenShift policy](https://github.com/openshift/enhancements/blob/master/enhancements/release/improving-ci-signal.md#quick-revert), we are reverting this breaking change to get CI and/or nightly payloads flowing again.
>
>This PR (a revert-of-revert) adds `operandsConverged()` with `RequeueAfter: 30*time.Second`, which causes the `cloud-controller-manager` operator to toggle `Progressing=True/False` every 30–60 seconds during MCO-driven node updates. This violates the upgrade monitoring invariant, causing the `aggregated-azure-ovn-upgrade-5.0-micro` blocking job to fail.
>
>Re-reverting restores the state from [TRT-2754](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/TRT-2754). The CCM progressing behavior needs to be reworked to avoid toggling during MCO updates before re-landing.
>
>Related: [TRT-2776](https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/TRT-2776) (CVO#1398 revert, same payload)
>
>[AI payload analysis report](https://gcsweb-ci.apps.ci.l2s4.p1.openshiftapps.com/gcs/prow-artifact-archive/logs/periodic-ci-openshift-release-main-claude-payload-agent/2074865918898343936/artifacts/claude-payload-agent/openshift-claude-payload-agent/artifacts/payload-analysis-5.0.0-0.nightly-2026-07-08-143208-summary.html)
>
>To unrevert this, revert this PR, and layer an additional separate commit on top that addresses the problem. Before merging the unrevert, please run these jobs on the PR and check the result of these jobs to confirm the fix has corrected the problem:
>
>```
>/payload-with-prs openshift/cluster-cloud-controller-manager-operator#NNNN 5.0.0-0.nightly e2e-azure-ovn-upgrade
>```
>
>CC: @theobarberbany


Instructions for interacting with me using PR comments are available [here](https://prow.ci.openshift.org/command-help?repo=openshift%2Fcluster-cloud-controller-manager-operator).  If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin](https://github.com/openshift-eng/jira-lifecycle-plugin/issues/new) repository.
</details>

Azure rolls a daemonset unlike the other clouds, when MCO upgrades nodes reboot, which means daemonset pods are rescheduled. The current logic in this patch doesn't account for this, hence setting progressing=True during MCO upgrade.
